MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next addition because it would let me control a household device through the Echo speakers and display I already use.",
    "The Blink doorbell and WYZE Cam v3 connect my interest in Alexa devices with my earlier door alarm interaction, adding home monitoring capabilities rather than repeating something I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Both Fire TV Stick recommendations overlap with my existing 4K Max bundle, and another Echo display feels premature after my recent Show 5 and stand interactions.",
    "The earbuds do not address a current need, and the iPad stylus assumes tablet use that my computer keyboard interactions do not establish.",
    "The WYZE Cam v2 and Blink XT2 are relevant to home monitoring, but I would start with the doorbell and v3 before adding more cameras."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa-related activity seems to be taken as a reason to suggest more streaming sticks and displays, even when they repeat functions I already have.",
    "My interest in electronics and Apple-compatible computer accessories seems to stretch too far into earbuds and an iPad-only accessory."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Fire TV bundle and Echo Show 5 stand interactions suggest I am already equipped for streaming and a small smart display; useful additions matter more to me now.",
    "Compatibility with my existing devices and a distinct practical purpose matter: a smart plug adds control, while a doorbell adds doorstep monitoring.",
    "Interest in home monitoring does not mean I want several camera systems at once; I would first choose devices with clear, complementary uses."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in an Alexa-connected home, but sometimes confused useful additions with duplicate devices or unrelated electronics."
}
